# Fixtures for test_lfm_finetune_jetson_skills.py

Small, trimmed copies of the two eval shapes used by
`NVIDIA-AI-IOT/jetson-device-skills` (the `device/` tree, dict-of-list
`evals.json`) and `NVIDIA-AI-IOT/jetson-bsp-skills` (the `bsp/` tree,
list `evals.json`), two skills each, one or two evals per skill.

Reproduced under the source repositories' terms (documentation CC-BY-4.0,
source code Apache-2.0); attributed here to
[NVIDIA-AI-IOT/jetson-device-skills](https://github.com/NVIDIA-AI-IOT/jetson-device-skills)
and
[NVIDIA-AI-IOT/jetson-bsp-skills](https://github.com/NVIDIA-AI-IOT/jetson-bsp-skills).
These are test fixtures only, trimmed for size and readability -- not the
full 104-eval set the real build produces from the pinned commits.
